blocks.text: PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. ordered police commanders to intensify the crackdown on suspects using rider uniforms, delivery boxes and other motorcycle delivery gear to blend into crowded communities and carry out robberies and other crimes.
